obsolescence_risks: The rerun is a NEW SAMPLE, not a repair: pool ordering and RNG differ, so its number will not equal -0.043 exactly. -0.043 is the free-levels re-grade on the 350 clean fires of the ORIGINAL cube and remains the sensitivity bound; this rerun is the clean measurement. Both are reported, neither is silently substituted for the other.

The 23 contaminated trades cluster in the run's opening weeks, so the original cfg1 and its clean subset are not the same WINDOW. The rerun removes that objection by covering the full window with no wipe.

If this rerun's own legs cross a resume boundary, the B2574 fix is what must hold; the landing battery's replay_atr_proxy lens will report the MEASURED rate from replay_atr_fallback.json rather than inferring it, which is the check that decides whether the rerun succeeded on its own terms.

Engine drift is ALLOWED here by design (allow_engine_drift), because the whole point is to run under a DIFFERENT engine than the original landing. The landing record carries the engine hash so the two cubes remain distinguishable.
wall_clock_projection_basis: the original cfg1 landing's own manifest projection, 200 tickers x 1 year pooled at 4 workers. The sixteen b2527 configs measured 7289 s to 22949 s elapsed (output_audit/icg_*_wave_summary.json), so 4.04 h sits inside that range and under the owner's 5 h local cap.
